title: Corporate workload to capital
given: A technical owner defines an accepted workload; finance holds a protected BTX reserve.
steps: Compare equivalent alternatives, select a local recipe, create allocation, obtain distinct approvals, fund where required, hand off and verify a useful local result.
assertions: Separate actual money, forecast/actual cost, local authorization and readiness; preserve the reserve floor.

title: Institutional reserve mandate
given: An institutional legal account with existing custody and OTC adapters.
steps: Establish a reserve policy, approve bounded replenishment, execute an actual test order and allocate to a native capability release.
assertions: Mandate and quote limits hold, reporting reconciles and no inference hot-path charge is created.

title: Family operating companies
given: A principal, adviser, two companies and foundation with separate accounts.
steps: Draft a group programme, choose each payer, obtain separate authority and deploy the output to permitted company devices.
assertions: Group visibility never pools funds or authorizes an adviser debit.

title: Foundation research
given: A foundation has a finite research allocation and committed native bounty terms.
steps: Join a programme, approve one lot, process submission/evaluation under native rules and claim or refund as appropriate.
assertions: No equity, revenue right or indefinite spend is inferred from the sponsorship.

title: Free cold acquisition
given: A clean walletless client and a public capability.
steps: Discover via hosted catalogue, pair device, accept finite local grant, verify package and acquire from native peers.
assertions: No wallet synchronization, CEX toll or untrusted software installation occurs.

title: Resident base and LAN adapter
given: A base is resident and an exact compatible adapter is on LAN.
steps: Receive a CEX internet source hint, resolve locally, fetch only missing verified data and prepare runtime.
assertions: The same locked recipe completes with recorded reuse and no private inventory upload.

title: Reserve replenishment concurrency
given: Multiple replicas receive repeated low-reserve events.
steps: Run SUGGEST then separately authorized AUTO mode through cooldown, turnover and price changes.
assertions: One owned order at a time, no unintended trade in SUGGEST and safe ambiguous-order handling.

title: Committee changes mid-plan
given: A multi-person approval packet has nearly reached quorum.
steps: Change amount, revoke a role, expire a quote and retry final approval/submit.
assertions: No stale authority is accepted and the UI explains the specific new review.

title: Conversion partial success
given: A conversion is executed before native funding.
steps: Expire the funding terms, lose one response, restart workers and resume the parent allocation.
assertions: BTX remains in the account; no automatic reverse or duplicated conversion/funding.

title: Unknown native broadcast
given: Actual isolated native transaction dispatch loses its response.
steps: Restart all gateways, recover signer/outbox and reconcile the original bytes and outpoint.
assertions: One debit, one authorized native transaction and correct eventual receipt.

title: Independent co-sponsors
given: Three independent entities contribute to one programme.
steps: Aggregate progress, complete one claim and one refund branch under native terms.
assertions: Every customer lot and beneficiary remains independently attributed.

title: Refund and reserve authority
given: A funded lot reaches a valid native refund condition.
steps: Prepare, authorize, execute, confirm and credit refund; submit a new allocation.
assertions: Balance restores but lifetime mandate remains consumed unless explicitly renewed.

title: Infrastructure partner
given: A capital plan requires additional approved hardware.
steps: Request a partner offer and referral, then record actual separately authorized product progression.
assertions: Referral is not a loan, GPU purchase or funded BTX output; fees follow real events.

title: Collateral interaction
given: Existing partner product encumbers portfolio BTX.
steps: Run concurrent funding and collateral updates through the real account adapter.
assertions: Funds cannot be allocated twice and reserve snapshot states remain intelligible.

title: Board reporting
given: Multiple currencies, invoices, holdings and commitments exist.
steps: Import cost data, generate consistent entity/group reports, export pinned FOCUS fields and correct an observation.
assertions: No false NAV, double fees, stale zero valuation or forecast-as-actual saving.

title: Adviser revocation
given: An adviser has access to drafts and reports across selected entities.
steps: Revoke access during a queued export and attempted approval.
assertions: No new unauthorized disclosure or execution; historical audit remains intact.

title: Two-provider customer exit
given: Customer has acquired public capability and pending finance at provider A.
steps: Export exact packages/locks/receipts, disconnect A and enroll B for new discovery.
assertions: Local capability persists; A obligations stay attributed; no financial replay at B.

title: Accessible browser and agent parity
given: A first-time user and a scoped agent access the built portal and SDK.
steps: Complete workload, reserve review, approval, handoff and progress with keyboard/reader and typed APIs.
assertions: Both use identical immutable contracts and no terminal or unsafe token handoff.

title: Outage and load
given: Measured API/job load with one slow auxiliary product service.
steps: Fail gateway leader, database connections, report consumer and hosted connectivity while a local model is active.
assertions: Financial recovery remains fenced, resources bounded and local public use continues.

title: Integrated candidate
given: Final fingerprint, baseline contract artifacts and all supported backends.
steps: Run50newoperations,190newcases,120basecases and relevant AHP/JIT journeys; obtain independent review.
assertions: Report actual evidence tiers, fix real blockers and stop for operator release approval.
